seo.title: 6 Days Fascinating Assam Meghalaya Tour Package - Kajaawa
seo.description: In this tour Assam Meghalaya Tour Package you will visit Shillong, Cherrapunji, Dawki and Kaziranga at the best deals offered by Kajaawa

content.text: The tour to these beautiful states of northeast India is the best part. Meghalaya also known as the abode of clouds offers a tremendous number of tourist sights to visit. Stretching from the huge lavish green mountains to the big waterfalls falling majestically from a certain height, every single phenomena here is breathtaking. Also the historic state of Assam is not less. Here you can find great institutes to visit and unique parks and world renowned Natural Wild Life Park Of Kaziranga, Assam endowed with nature and many more.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Head to Shillong and on the way stop and enjoy the view of the grand Umiam Lake
Rejuvenate yourself by visiting the beautiful Ward's Lake and the lush green Lady Hydari Park
Explore the beautiful waterfalls, cave and park at Cherrapunji
Witness the cleanest village and the crystal clear Umngot River
Camping overnight amidst bonfire beside the calm and serene Umngot River
Experience Wildlife Safari on the back of an Elephant and also on Jeep at Kaziranga National Park
Witness the rare and endangered one-horned rhinoceros, tiger and other animals and birds

main.title: Fascinating Assam Meghalaya Tour Package Itinerary

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati and travel to Shillong
items: Start your journey on arrival at Guwahati from where you will be picked up and driven to Shillong.
On the way, enjoy the view of the wonderful Umiam Lake and take good photographs there.
Reach Shillong and check in to your hotel.
Later move out and have a local visit to the nearby places like Orchidarium, Ward’s Lake and Lady Hydari Park etc.
Get back to your hotel and spend time in leisure.

days.title: Day 2 : Cherrapunji Day Trip
items: Wake up early in the morning and have your breakfast.
Begin your wonderful trip to Cherrapunji.
Enroute visit the beautiful Elephant Falls.
Visit the Mawkdok Dympep Valley, Seven Sisters Falls, Nohkalikai Falls and Mawsmai Cave, etc.
Also visit Garden of Caves and Eco Park.

days.title: Day 3 : Mawlynnong and Dawki Tour
items: Start your journey to Mawlynnong and Dawki in the morning after your breakfast.
You will explore Mawlynnong once awarded by UNESCO as the cleanest village of Asia.
Visit the Jingmaham Living Root Bridge a self evolved bridge from the roots of the trees.
Drive ahead to Dawki, one of the popular sites in Meghalaya.
Umngot River of Dawki is famous as one of the crystal clear river.
Boat in the crystal clear water and see the river bed and aquatic life clearly.
Visit Tamabil border town, an international border between Bangladesh and India.
Later head to Shnognpdeng for camping with bonfire beside the Umngot River.

days.title: Day 4 : Shillong to Kaziranga
items: Early morning after breakfast drive to Kaziranga National Park.
Enjoy the scenic ride of 5- 6 hrs journey from Shillong To Kaziranga.
You can do photoshoot at Umiam Lake while on the way.
Check in at the resort/hotel and spend your evening at leisure.

days.title: Day 5 : Explore Kaziranga National Park
items: Early morning get ready for an adventurous tour of Kaziranga.
Explore the wild fauna and flora of this majestic forest.
Take an Elephant Safari in the Western Range and witness the life of wild animals including the famous one-horned Rhinoceros.
Apart from the one-horned rhinoceros, tiger, rare birds and deer are the main attractions of Kaziranga National Park.
Later go for a Jeep Safari and explore the wildlife closely in the Central Range of the Park.
After exploring wildlife at the park return back to the resort/hotel for rest.

days.title: Day 6 : Departure
items: Today you will depart from Kaziranga, taking all the beautiful memories of your Meghalaya and Assam Tour.
You will be dropped back to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station for your journey ahead.
